artifacts.title: Grounds and procedures for removing members from PCA church rolls
artifacts.disposition: declined to answer specific questions; general advice given

matches.evidence: Declining to address case-specific questions, the CCB outlined the three BCO provisions by which members may be removed from church rolls: transfer, discipline, or relocation.

artifacts.title: Procedure for removing members who relocate without affiliating elsewhere

matches.evidence: BCO 46-2 governs removal of members who move away and fail to affiliate within a year; BCO 46-5's formal discipline applies only to willful neglect, not mere relocation.
